scenarios.title: Payment Issue — Verify Your Account
scenarios.desc: A slowly-constructed phishing email that pretends to be from your payment provider.
scenarios.subject: Action required: Unusual payment detected
scenarios.body_text:
Dear user,

We noticed unusual activity on your account. Click the secure link to verify and avoid suspension:

https://paypal-secure-login.com/verify

Thank you,
Support Team
attack_flow: You clicked the malicious link which submitted credentials to attacker-controlled server.
Attacker used saved credentials to log into your account from a foreign IP.
Attacker changed your recovery email and password and enabled payment approvals.
Attacker transferred funds to a mule account and listed personal data on a leak forum.
scenarios.damage_summary: Immediate account takeover — unauthorized transfers and personal data leak.

scenarios.title: HR Vacation Request (Targeted)
scenarios.desc: A targeted message referencing company and colleague names — crafted to be trusted.
scenarios.subject: Re: Leave approval for Tony — immediate action required
scenarios.body_text:
Hey Tony,

Please review this attached leave approval and click the link to confirm.

Link: https://company-payroll.com/approve/tony

Thanks,
HR
red_flags: Domain similar to company domain but different
attack_flow: You clicked and entered your work credentials on the fake portal.
Attacker used credentials to access internal systems.
Attacker exfiltrated internal documents and initiated invoice changes.
Compromise caused sensitive data exposure and fraudulent vendor payments.
scenarios.damage_summary: Internal credentials stolen — internal data leak and finance fraud possible.
tips: Confirm with colleagues via a separate channel

scenarios.title: Bank SMS — OTP Required
scenarios.desc: SMS claiming an urgent OTP is required directing to a malicious link.
scenarios.body_text: Your bank account is temporarily locked. Unlock here: https://secure-bank-verify.com/otp
red_flags: Link domain not the official bank site
attack_flow: You tapped the SMS link and entered banking details.
Attacker used the details to initiate a transfer and requested OTP via SMS.
With control over both OTP and credentials, attacker authorized the transfer.
Bank account balance decreased and recovery required litigation.
scenarios.damage_summary: Bank account drained using social-engineered OTP/credentials.
tips: Never enter credentials from SMS links
Call bank via official number if unsure

scenarios.title: Fake Bank Call — Verification
scenarios.desc: Caller claims to be bank support, asks for account verification and OTP.
scenarios.body_text: Caller: 'We noticed suspicious transfers. Please share OTP to verify — we can stop it.'
attack_flow: You provided OTP during call believing caller.
Attacker validated OTP and completed unauthorized transfer.
Funds were moved out and transaction details hidden.
Recovery required bank escalation and dispute — slow process.
scenarios.damage_summary: OTP disclosure allowed attacker to complete transfers.
tips: Banks never ask for OTPs over phone
Hang up and call official bank number

scenarios.title: Google OAuth Fake Consent
scenarios.desc: Fake 'Sign in with Google' page that requests permissions.
scenarios.body_text: This site is requesting full access to your Google Drive and Gmail.
red_flags: OAuth consent page requests excessive permissions
attack_flow: You consent to the fake OAuth request.
Attacker gained token-scoped access to emails and files.
Sensitive documents were downloaded and emails sent from your account.
Attack spread to contacts and internal systems.
scenarios.damage_summary: OAuth token misuse leads to data leak and impersonation.
tips: Deny access if scope is excessive

scenarios.title: Invoice Attachment (Malicious)
scenarios.desc: Attachment disguised as invoice contains trojan that runs on open.
scenarios.preview: Please review the attached invoice and approve payment.
attack_flow: You opened the attachment; ransomware trojan executed.
Trojan quietly installed and began encrypting documents.
Ransom note appeared — files encrypted and backup inaccessible.
Business continuity impacted; backups needed to restore.
scenarios.damage_summary: Files encrypted; operations and finances impacted.

scenarios.title: Fake Installer — Ransomware
scenarios.desc: A fake 'tool' installer that encrypts files on execution.
scenarios.preview: Installer requires admin rights to run — 'Start' to continue.
attack_flow: You executed the installer, granting admin rights.
Ransomware began encrypting local & mapped network drives.
Ransom demand displayed with a countdown.
Data lost and business-critical operations halted.
scenarios.damage_summary: Critical systems encrypted; recovery expensive and slow.

scenarios.title: QR Code Payment Request
scenarios.desc: A QR code sticker claims to be for 'Refund' but points to a malicious page.
attack_flow: You scanned QR and were redirected to fake login.
You entered credentials and 2FA was captured.
Attackers used credentials + 2FA to take accounts.
Funds and personal info were lost.
scenarios.damage_summary: QR redirect led to credential theft.
tips: Use trusted app stores for scanning

scenarios.title: Deepfake Request from Friend
scenarios.desc: Short video clip of a family member asking for urgent money; voice is AI-synthesized.
scenarios.preview: Urgent! Please send ₹30,000 to this account now.
attack_flow: You sent money thinking it was your relative.
Attacker confirmed and requested more funds.
Victim realized after funds were gone; scarce traceability.
Emotional stress and financial loss.
tips: Call the person on known number before sending money
Use video verification or alternative channels

scenarios.title: Fake Utility App Requesting Dangerous Permissions
scenarios.desc: Mobile app from unknown vendor requesting access to call, SMS, and storage.
scenarios.preview: Permissions requested: read SMS, send SMS, access storage.
red_flags: Permissions not needed for app function
attack_flow: You installed app and granted SMS & storage access.
App sent premium SMS and exfiltrated contacts and files.
Attacker used contact list to spread scam and monetize via premium services.
Carrier bills and data breach occurred.
